                                                ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Munieipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing the DX-5 Downtown Mixed-Use District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 1-F in the area bounded by

A line 50 feet north of and parallel to West Superior Street; the alley next east of and parallel to North Wells
Street; West Superior Street; and a line 59.65 feet east of and parallel to North Wells Street.

to those of a DR-5 Downtown Residential District


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.
